claims.claim: 以已确诊冠心病患者为对象的荟萃分析（41 项随机对照试验，6276 例）显示，速效救心丸组心电图改善优于硝酸甘油组（RR 1.35，95% CI 1.16 to 1.56，P<0.001）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis.…The subgroup analyses indicated that suxiao jiuxin pill improved ECG results more than … nitroglycerin (RR 1.35, 95% CI 1.16 to 1.56, P < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 已确诊冠心病/心绞痛患者；慢性管理与疗效替代指标场景，不适用于未分化急性胸痛院外自救
claims.uncertainty: 替代终点（心电图改善）；纳入研究质量低；全部为中文来源

claims.claim: 速效救心丸组与对照组不良反应发生率差异无统计学意义（RR 1.12，95% CI 0.50 to 2.51，P=0.785），最常见为轻度头痛、头晕与面部潮红。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing…There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 已确诊冠心病/心绞痛患者
claims.uncertainty: 不良反应报告不全；无严重不良事件/硬终点数据

claims.claim: 该荟萃分析纳入研究的方法学质量低（多数因缺乏双盲而 Jadad 评分低），且作者明确未分析心血管死亡或药物相关并发症。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design…In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications.
claims.applicability: 证据质量评价，适用于所有引用该荟萃分析的结论
claims.uncertainty: 无

claims.claim: 该荟萃分析对象为冠心病患者（41 项研究共 6276 例，全部来自中国），属已确诊冠心病的疗效证据，其结论不能外推到未分化急性胸痛院外自救场景。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: All of the included studies were conducted in China…The 41 studies consisted of 6276 patients with coronary heart disease
claims.applicability: 场景边界声明：慢性管理证据不得用于急性自救推荐
claims.uncertainty: 无直接急性发作场景证据

claims.claim: 急诊前瞻性队列研究（270 例，4 周随访 95%）以先验定义的疼痛减轻≥3 分或完全缓解为"阳性反应"：其判别心源性胸痛的灵敏度为 72%（95%CI 64–80%）、特异度 37%（95%CI 34–41%）、阳性似然比 1.1（95%CI 0.96–1.34），χ² 检验无统计学意义（P=0.12），结论为缓解反应不可靠、不能区分心源性与非心源性胸痛。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: Results: 270 patients were enrolled.…The diagnostic sensitivity of nitroglycerin to determine cardiac chest pain was 72% (64%–80%), and the specificity was 37% (34%–41%)…was 1.1 (0.96–1.34)…Telephone follow-up at 4 weeks was performed, with a 95% follow-up rate…Positive response to NTG — defined a priori as a reduction of 3 points or more in the pain scale or complete pain relief…Using a Pearson χ2, NTG was found not to be statistically significant (p = 0.12)
claims.applicability: 急诊已接受硝酸甘油治疗的成人胸痛患者；诊断价值结论
claims.uncertainty: 便利样本；单中心；非盲（主治医师知晓用药反应）

claims.claim: 270 例中 177 例（66%）硝酸甘油后疼痛缓解，其中仅 34%（60/177）为心源性、66%（117/177）为非心源性；35 例确诊心肌梗死中 20 例缓解、15 例未缓解。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: One hundred and seventy-seven of 270 patients showed a positive response to NTG (66%), and 93/270 (34%) showed a negative response…Of those patients who experienced relief with NTG, 60/177 (34%) had defined cardiac chest pain and 117/177 (66%) had non-cardiac chest pain…There were 35 AMIs, based on troponin levels in the study population. Of those diagnosed with AMI, 20 experienced relief with NTG and 15 did not
claims.applicability: 急诊胸痛人群；心源性胸痛可不缓解、非心源性胸痛可缓解
claims.uncertainty: 反应判定阈值（疼痛减少≥3 分）为研究者先验设定

claims.claim: Steele 等 2006 报告其结论与既往研究（Shry 2002、Henrikson 2003、Diercks 2005）一致；其中 Diercks 等（Ann Emerg Med 2005）研究 664 例。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: This study corroborates recent work done by Shry and colleagues…Henrikson and coworkers…and Diercks and associates
claims.applicability: 二手转述：Diercks 等原始研究全文未获开放获取，本引用以其在 Steele 等 2006 对照表中的转述为限
claims.uncertainty: Diercks 2005 原始全文未核读；其样本量 664 例（以及 Shry 2002 的 251 例、Henrikson 2003 的 459 例）取自本文献表 2 的 'No. of patients included in study' 行，属对照表转述；本主张的核实层级为转述而非原始全文

claims.claim: 纯化酶研究显示 ALDH2*2 的 GTN 脱硝基最大速率约为野生型的 1/7（5.0 对 36 nmol·min⁻¹·mg⁻¹）、表观亲和力约降低 7 倍（Km 54 对 7.6 µmol/L），在药理相关低浓度（2 µmol/L GTN）下的 GTN 还原速率较野生型低约 35 倍（0.24±0.02 对 8.6±0.19 nmol·min⁻¹·mg⁻¹）。
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of the East Asian Variant of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase-2
claims.supportQuote: ALDH2*2 catalyzed GTN denitration with ∼7-fold lower maximal rates than ALDH2*1 (5.0 ± 0.10 versus 36 ± 1.4 nmol of 1,2-GDN × min −1 × mg −1 in the presence of 0.2 m m GTN). In addition, the apparent GTN affinity of ALDH2*2 was ∼7-fold lower (apparent K m values of 54 ± 6.0 and 7.6 ± 1.4 μ m for ALDH2*2 and ALDH2*1, respectively), resulting in pronounced, 35-fold lower rates of GTN reduction at pharmacologically relevant low concentrations of the nitrate (0.24 ± 0.02 versus 8.6 ± 0.19 nmol 1,2-GDN × min −1 × mg −1 for ALDH2*2 and ALDH2*1 in the presence of 2 μ m GTN)
claims.applicability: 体外酶动力学；解释低剂量硝酸甘油在携带者中疗效降低的机制
claims.uncertainty: 体外数据外推至体内受蛋白表达、辅因子可用性等影响

claims.claim: ALDH2*2 的 GTN 脱硝基最大速率与 GTN 亲和力均约为野生型的 1/7（7 倍降低），但一氧化氮生成速率仅降低 2 倍。
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of the East Asian Variant of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase-2
claims.supportQuote: Although ALDH2*2 exhibited 7-fold lower GTN denitrating activity and GTN affinity than ALDH2*1, the rate of nitric oxide formation was only reduced 2-fold
claims.applicability: 体外酶动力学；支持疗效为程度性降低而非完全缺失
claims.uncertainty: 脱硝基与生物活化是否为独立通路仍存在争议（作者自述）

claims.claim: 在确诊冠心病患者中，舌下含服硝酸甘油缓解缺血性胸痛的有效率由非携带者的 85.1% 降至至少携带一个 ALDH2*2 等位基因者的 57.6%（Li 等 2006 数据，经 Beretta 等 2010 转述）。
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of the East Asian Variant of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase-2
claims.supportQuote: Another study reported that the efficacious rate of sublingual GTN, measured as reduction of ischemic chest pain of patients having documented coronary artery disease, was reduced from 85.1% in controls to 57.6% in subjects carrying at least one ALDH2*2 allele
claims.applicability: 确诊冠心病患者；携带者中超过半数仍可获得疗效
claims.uncertainty: 二手转述（原始研究 JCI 2006 全文未获开放获取）；无置信区间；疗效判定标准未展开

claims.claim: 作者据酶动力学外推：携带 ALDH2*2 者对低剂量硝酸甘油的血管反应应减弱、高剂量反应应保留，且有相当多证据表明携带 E487K 突变者仍对硝酸甘油有反应。
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of the East Asian Variant of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase-2
claims.supportQuote: Extrapolation of our data obtained with purified enzymes to the in vivo situation would imply that the vascular response to low doses of GTN should be reduced in subjects carrying the ALDH2*2 allele, whereas the response to high doses should be preserved.…Thus, there is considerable evidence that subjects expressing the E487K mutant are still responsive to GTN.
claims.applicability: 机制外推（作者表述）；支持携带者疗效降低而非无效
claims.uncertainty: 外推为作者推断；个体差异大

claims.claim: ALDH2*2（显性负性变异）在不同东亚亚人群中的出现率为 35%–57%。
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of the East Asian Variant of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase-2
claims.supportQuote: A dominant-negative ALDH2 polymorphism resulting in markedly reduced alcohol tolerance has been described…that occurs with an incidence of 35–57% in different East Asian subpopulations
claims.applicability: 东亚人群携带率范围；用于“约半数”说的数量级核验
claims.uncertainty: 不同亚人群间差异大；引用文献为 1990 年代研究

claims.claim: 约 45% 的汉族（东亚）人群携带 ALDH2*2 突变；rs671 在东亚人群中等位基因频率 26.6%，为全球最常见的失活突变；杂合子（*1/*2）酶活性为野生型的 25%–40%。
claims.sourceTitle: Novel and prevalent non-East Asian ALDH2 variants; Implications for global susceptibility to aldehydes' toxicity
claims.supportQuote: About 45% of Han Chinese (East Asians), accounting for 8% of humans, carry a single point mutation in ALDH2*2 (E504K)…the ALDH2*2 (E504K) variant is the most prevalent genetic variant worldwide, with an allele frequency of 26.6% among East Asians…The ALDH2 activity of human carriers of the heterozygous ALDH2* 1/ * 2 genotype is 25–40% of wild type enzyme
claims.applicability: 汉族与东亚人群携带率与残余活性；“约半数”说的数量级锚点
claims.uncertainty: 基于 ExAC 数据库（2019 年数据）；残余活性估计与其他来源存在分歧

claims.sourceTitle: Geographical distribution of ALDH2 rs671 polymorphism in Chinese angina pectoris patients
claims.supportQuote: A total of 1,084 angina pectoris patients were recruited from the three aforementioned regions.…In eastern China (Jiaxing), the G and A allele frequencies were 77.99% and 22.01%, respectively, with the wild-type GG genotype occurring in 59.66% of cases, the heterozygous GA genotype in 36.65%, and the homozygous AA genotype in 3.69%. In northern China (Luoyang), the G and A allele frequencies were 85.25% and 14.75%, respectively, with GG, GA, and AA genotype frequencies of 72.47%, 25.56%, and 1.97%. In southern China (Guilin), the G and A allele frequencies were 78.09% and 21.91%, respectively, with corresponding GG, GA, and AA genotype frequencies of 60.75%, 34.68%, and 4.57%…the relatively small number of AA genotype carriers (n = 13) limits the statistical power
claims.applicability: 中国心绞痛患者（1084 例，三中心）；人群学频率
claims.uncertainty: 三地未覆盖全中国；患者样本而非一般人群；横断面设计

claims.claim: 该研究（转述 Lai 等 2014）报告杂合子仅保留约 10% 的酶活性，纯合突变者完全缺乏酶活性。
claims.sourceTitle: Geographical distribution of ALDH2 rs671 polymorphism in Chinese angina pectoris patients
claims.supportQuote: Heterozygous individuals retain only about 10% of the enzyme activity compared to wild-type individuals, while homozygous mutants completely lack enzymatic activity
claims.applicability: 残余活性估计；与 EBioMedicine 的 25%–40% 估计存在分歧
claims.uncertainty: 二手转述；不同测定体系结果不一致

claims.claim: 该研究转述：携带突变等位基因者接受硝酸甘油后冠状动脉直径与收缩压变化显著小于野生型（Zhang 2025）；日本志愿者随机交叉试验中 ALDH2*2 携带者的硝酸甘油扩血管反应较野生型降低约 40%。
claims.sourceTitle: Geographical distribution of ALDH2 rs671 polymorphism in Chinese angina pectoris patients
claims.supportQuote: Zhang et al. demonstrated that patients with mutant ALDH2 alleles had significantly lower changes in coronary artery diameter and systolic blood pressure after nitroglycerin administration compared to wild-type individuals…individuals carrying the mutant ALDH2*2 allele exhibited approximately 40% less vasodilatory response to nitroglycerin compared to wild-type controls
claims.applicability: 中国与日本人群的基因型-反应关联
claims.uncertainty: 均为该文转述的既往研究；原文参数未核读

claims.claim: ALDH2*2 变异在东亚人群中流行率 30%–50%，携带者对硝酸甘油反应较差且更易发生硝酸甘油耐受。
claims.sourceTitle: Coronary artery spasm — Clinical features, pathogenesis and treatment
claims.supportQuote: The deficient variant ALDH2 genotype ( ALDH2*2 ) is prevalent (30–50%) among East Asians, but rare in other populations…Accordingly, carriers of ALDH2*2 genotypes are less responsive to nitroglycerin and are more susceptible to nitroglycerin tolerance and ROS.
claims.applicability: 东亚人群携带率；硝酸甘油反应与耐受
claims.uncertainty: 综述性来源；原始数据未逐项核读

claims.claim: 冠状动脉痉挛性心绞痛急性发作通常可被舌下含服硝酸甘油或硝酸异山梨酯迅速缓解。
claims.sourceTitle: Coronary artery spasm — Clinical features, pathogenesis and treatment
claims.supportQuote: Attacks of CAS can usually be promptly relieved by sublingual administration or oral spray of nitroglycerin or isosorbide dinitrate (ISDN).
claims.applicability: 痉挛性心绞痛（心源性胸痛亚型）对硝酸甘油高度敏感——机制上解释心源性胸痛普遍缓解的现象
claims.uncertainty: 心源性胸痛中亚型差异大，不能反推诊断

claims.claim: 叙述性系统综述（检索 2000–2025 年文献）报告：观察性研究显示每 30 分钟的再灌注延迟与相对死亡风险增加相关。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-Hospital Delay in STEMI: A Narrative Review of Symptom Onset-to-First Medical Contact Across High-Income and Low- and Middle-Income Countries
claims.supportQuote: Observational studies have reported that each 30‐min delay in reperfusion is associated with an increase in relative mortality risk…covering publications from 2000 to 2025
claims.applicability: STEMI 再灌注延迟与死亡风险；支撑“时间即心肌”与呼救优先
claims.uncertainty: 观察性证据；效应量未在综述中给出数值

claims.claim: 溶栓治疗在症状发作后第一小时内最有效（“黄金小时”），临床获益可延续至症状发作后数小时。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-Hospital Delay in STEMI: A Narrative Review of Symptom Onset-to-First Medical Contact Across High-Income and Low- and Middle-Income Countries
claims.supportQuote: Thrombolytic therapy is most effective when administered within the first hour after symptom onset (“the golden hour”), although clinical benefit may extend for several hours after symptom onset
claims.applicability: 再灌注时间窗；支撑缩短院前延迟的紧迫性
claims.uncertainty: 叙述性综述转述；原始时间-获益曲线未核读

claims.claim: 高收入国家症状发作至首次医疗接触中位时间通常为 60–120 分钟；包括中国在内的多个中低收入国家报告延迟常超过 300–480 分钟。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-Hospital Delay in STEMI: A Narrative Review of Symptom Onset-to-First Medical Contact Across High-Income and Low- and Middle-Income Countries
claims.supportQuote: median symptom onset–to–first medical contact intervals in high‐income countries are typically 60–120 min…In several LMIC settings, symptom onset–to–FMC delays frequently exceed 300 min and may extend beyond 480 min
claims.applicability: 院前延迟的国别差异；中国属中低收入场景
claims.uncertainty: 叙述性综述；各国登记口径不一

claims.claim: Yang 等（CAMI 注册）报告中国 STEMI 患者中仅少数使用急救医疗服务，多数选择自行或私家车转运，而使用 EMS 与更短的院内延迟相关。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-Hospital Delay in STEMI: A Narrative Review of Symptom Onset-to-First Medical Contact Across High-Income and Low- and Middle-Income Countries
claims.supportQuote: A study conducted by Yang et al. in China reported that only a minority of STEMI patients used EMS, with most patients opting for private or self‐transport, despite EMS use being associated with shorter hospital delays
claims.applicability: 中国 STEMI 患者急救服务使用行为
claims.uncertainty: 二手转述 Yang 等研究；具体使用率数值未在本综述给出

claims.claim: 非典型症状常被患者误归因于胃肠道等非心源性原因，导致就医前延迟延长。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-Hospital Delay in STEMI: A Narrative Review of Symptom Onset-to-First Medical Contact Across High-Income and Low- and Middle-Income Countries
claims.supportQuote: Such atypical symptoms are frequently misattributed to gastrointestinal causes, which contributes to prolonged delay before seeking care
claims.applicability: 症状识别与延迟机制；支撑“不以症状/用药反应自我判断”
claims.uncertainty: 叙述性综述

claims.claim: ACC/AHA 与 ESC 指南一致强调早期激活急救系统（EMS）并快速转运至确定性救治机构。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-Hospital Delay in STEMI: A Narrative Review of Symptom Onset-to-First Medical Contact Across High-Income and Low- and Middle-Income Countries
claims.supportQuote: Prolonged pre‐hospital delays are consistently associated with adverse outcomes, including reduced eligibility for timely reperfusion and higher morbidity and mortality…which aligns with ACC/AHA and ESC guidelines emphasizing early EMS activation and rapid transport to definitive care
claims.applicability: 指南立场：先激活 EMS、快速转运；支撑呼救优先
claims.uncertainty: 指南原文未获全文核读（经本综述转述）

claims.claim: 中国 101 家非 PCI 医院 CPACS-3 注册（7312 例 STEMI）显示 67.1% 存在院前延迟（症状发作至到院 >120 分钟），中位症状发作至到院时间约 210 分钟，显著长于大都市医学中心报告的 113–150 分钟。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: A total of 7312 patients with STEMI were included.…The rates of prehospital delay, first ECG delay, thrombolytic therapy delay and in-hospital delay were 67.1%, 31.4%, 85.8% and 67.8%, respectively…the median symptoms onset-to-arrival time was about 113–150 min…the median time found in our study was much longer, about 210 min
claims.applicability: 中国基层（非 PCI）医院 STEMI 患者院前延迟
claims.uncertainty: 症状发作时间为患者自报，存在回忆偏倚；排除到院即死亡者（幸存者偏倚）

claims.claim: 症状发作至到院时间占接受溶栓治疗者总缺血时间的三分之二，是延迟的主导段；未接受溶栓者中约半数在症状发作 6 小时后才到院。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: symptoms onset-to-arrival time was the dominant time segment, accounting for two-thirds of the total ischaemic time among those who received thrombolytic therapy…half of the patients not receiving thrombolytic therapy arrived at the hospital beyond 6 hours after their disease onset
claims.applicability: 中国 STEMI 总缺血时间的结构；院前段为主要可干预环节
claims.uncertainty: 非 PCI 医院场景；结果向城市 PCI 中心外推受限

claims.claim: 英国国家卫生服务体系（NHS）官方患者指导：突发、持续的胸痛可能为心脏病发作，应立即呼叫急救（英国 999，中国对应 120），因为需要立即住院治疗。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Call 999 if: - you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion…You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 患者端急救行为指导（英国 999；中国本地化为 120）
claims.uncertainty: 英国语境；急救号码需本地化

claims.claim: 美国心脏协会现行心肺复苏与心血管急救（CPR/ECC）指南为 2025 年版，并设有指南重点更新机制。
claims.sourceTitle: CPR and ECC Guidelines | American Heart Association CPR & First Aid
claims.supportQuote: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for CPR and ECC
claims.applicability: 急救科学指南时效性背景
claims.uncertainty: 页面为指南入口页，不含具体推荐文本

claims.claim: 以携带率衡量，北方汉族心绞痛患者 ALDH2*2 携带率（GA+AA）约 27.5%，东部约 40.3%，南部约 39.3%；"约半数中国人"仅对东部、南部与东亚整体（35%–57%）成立，对北方汉族不成立。
claims.method: 携带率=GA 基因型频率+AA 基因型频率：洛阳 25.56%+1.97%=27.53%；嘉兴 36.65%+3.69%=40.34%；桂林 34.68%+4.57%=39.25%；与 JBC 2010 报告的东西亚亚人群 35%–57% 及 EBioMedicine 的汉族约 45% 携带率对照。
claims.assumptions: 三地患者样本对其区域人群有代表性（作者经 Hardy-Weinberg 平衡检验支持，P>0.05）；心绞痛患者与一般人群基因型分布近似。
claims.sensitivity: 若抽样偏差使携带率变动 ±5 个百分点，北方为 22.5%–32.5%、东部/南部 34.3%–45.3%，北方仍显著低于 40% 的"约半数"下界。
claims.applicability: 中国境内"约半数中国人"说法的地域适用性
claims.uncertainty: 三地未覆盖全中国；患者样本非一般人群普查
claims.sourceTitle: Geographical distribution of ALDH2 rs671 polymorphism in Chinese angina pectoris patients

claims.claim: 以"含服硝酸甘油无效"口径加权估算：汉族人群预期无效率约 27%（0.2728），携带率 35%–57% 敏感性区间约 24.5%–30.6%，显著低于"半数"。
claims.assumptions: 携带者/非携带者的硝酸甘油有效率差异（85.1% 对 57.6%）可外推至一般用药人群；疗效判定口径与 Li 2006 一致；汉族携带率约 45%。
claims.sensitivity: 携带率 35%–57% 区间对应无效率 24.5%–30.6%（四舍五入约 25%–31%）；若按杂合子残余活性 10%（而非 25%–40%）估计疗效降幅更大，则无效率上移，但需携带率与疗效数据同时取不利端才接近 40%。
claims.applicability: "约半数中国人不起效"说的数值核验（无效口径）
claims.uncertainty: 疗效点估计（57.6%/85.1%）为二手转述且无置信区间；单研究数据
claims.sourceTitle: Characterization of the East Asian Variant of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase-2

claims.claim: 舌下含服硝酸甘油后症状缓解不能用作诊断或排除心源性胸痛的依据：Steele 2006 实测特异度 37%、灵敏度 72%，若把缓解误当作阳性判别，约 63% 的非心源性胸痛会被误判、35 例确诊心肌梗死中 15 例（约 43%）不缓解；因此缓解与否均不能区分心源性胸痛，症状持续时应接受急救评估。
claims.method: 假阳性率=1−特异度=1−0.37=0.63（特异度 37%、灵敏度 72% 为 Steele 2006 实测参数，源自 CLM-005）；心梗漏判比例=未缓解 AMI 数/AMI 总数=15/35≈0.429≈43%（源自 CLM-006）。
claims.assumptions: Steele 2006 队列的灵敏度/特异度参数代表急诊胸痛人群的一般情形；以缓解作为阳性判定。
claims.sensitivity: Diercks 2005（664 例）报告各疼痛变化亚组组间无差异，与之一致；若人群危重程度更高，灵敏度可能上升、特异度进一步下降，误判负担不减少。
claims.applicability: 症状反应作诊断工具的误判负担评估
claims.uncertainty: 队列为单中心便利样本；反应阈值定义影响参数

claims.claim: Steele 2006 与所转述的 Shry(2002)、Henrikson(2003)、Diercks(2005) 四项急诊胸痛研究（样本量 270、251、459、664 例）合计 1644 例，方向一致：缓解反应不能区分心源性与非心源性胸痛。
claims.method: 合计样本量=270+251+459+664=1644（4 项研究）；各项 n 值取自 Steele 2006 表 2（'No. of patients included in study' 行：25 1 459 664 2 70，即 251、459、664、270）。
claims.assumptions: 表 2 转述的既往研究（Shry 2002、Henrikson 2003、Diercks 2005）样本量与原始发表一致；四项研究以相同方向（缓解无诊断价值）得出结论。
claims.sensitivity: 若个别研究样本量统计口径存在出入，合计在 1600–1700 例之间变动，不改变方向性结论。
claims.applicability: 急诊胸痛人群中含服反应诊断价值的一致性证据基础；用于报告中的'四项研究合计'表述
claims.uncertainty: Diercks 2005 原始全文未核读，其样本量与结论经 Steele 2006 对照表转述
